title: Join us live this friday for our QGIS Open Day
content:
What happened in QGIS this month? Can we rival ESRI Network Analyst? How did the Samburu migrate? And how was it mapped? Find out at this month's QGIS Open Day, our monthly recap of updates and interesting stories from the QGIS community. We will be broadcasting live this Friday. 

 See the link for the programme or subscribe to the QGIS YouTube channel for notifications.
